description: Search ALLR's motorcycle-gear catalog (helmets, jackets, suits, pants, boots, gloves, protection, riding shirts, base layers, communication, luggage, accessories) by free text, and get each product's lowest landed cost for a buyer country, how many retailers carry it, and its allr.io product-page URL. The returned `id` is the product id accepted by get_product_offers, which has the per-retailer price table. The `lowest_landed_price` is the cheapest total including shipping, import duty and customs brokerage for `country` (for EU and UK this includes import VAT on cross-border offers; for CA and US no sales tax is included) — not a sticker price — and is one number out of a full table; get_product_offers has the per-retailer breakdown.

brand.description: Restrict to a brand. Accepts a `slug` or `name` from list_categories_and_brands. Applied as a brand-token filter on the matched products.

category.description: Restrict to a catalog category. Accepts a `slug` from list_categories_and_brands (e.g. 'helmets', 'jackets', 'boots').

certification.description: Restrict to products carrying this safety certification label, e.g. 'ECE 22.06', 'DOT', 'SNELL', 'CE AA'. Matched case-insensitively against the same certification labels the ALLR catalog filters on. A product whose certification ALLR cannot derive from its catalog row returns no `certifications` and is excluded by this filter — the product page is the fuller source for certification.

country.description: Buyer country (ISO-2, plus 'EU' and 'UK' as market codes). Determines the currency and the landed cost: item price + shipping + import duty + customs brokerage fee, plus import VAT on cross-border offers for EU and UK. CA and US totals carry no sales tax. ALLR computes landed cost for these four markets only.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor from a previous call's `next_cursor`. Absent on the first page.

gender.description: Restrict to products cut for this rider group, using ALLR's own gender classifier.

max_price.description: Highest acceptable landed price in the country's currency.

min_price.description: Lowest acceptable landed price in the country's currency.

query.description: Free-text search, e.g. 'agv k6', 'waterproof adventure jacket', 'alpinestars smx-6 boots'. Brand names, model names and model numbers all work.

name: search_gear

as_of.description: ISO-8601 timestamp at which these prices were assembled.

next_cursor.description: Value accepted as `cursor` for the next page; null when there are no more.

ranked_match_count.description: Number of RANKED RESULTS this query produced after the requested filters — the pool this call paginates over. ALLR's search engine ranks and returns at most 50 products per query, so this is NOT a catalog-wide match count: when `results_capped` is true, more products match than are rankable in one query. A narrower query (`brand`, `category` or more specific text) produces a ranked pool below the cap.

certifications.description: Safety certification labels ALLR holds for this product, e.g. 'ECE 22.06': the labels resolved from its retailers' pages (the same ones the product page shows), or inferred from the name when none is resolved. An EMPTY array means none is recorded, NOT that the product is uncertified.

id.description: ALLR product id, as accepted by get_product_offers.

in_stock_offer_count.description: The subset of `offer_count` in stock, from the same summary.

lowest_landed_price.description: Cheapest landed total (item + shipping + duty + brokerage, plus import VAT on cross-border EU and UK offers; no sales tax for CA and US) in `currency`, or null when no retailer currently prices it.

offer_count.description: New-condition retailer offers ALLR holds for this product in any market, each retailer counted once, from the twice-daily product summary. get_product_offers returns the live table, whose `offer_count` can differ slightly (it is read later and also lists non-new offers).

ships_to_country.description: True when at least one retailer ships this product to `country` (ALLR's own per-country rollup). False means no retailer currently reaches that country — which does NOT hide the product; ALLR shows every product in every region. null when the rollup is unavailable for this row: unknown, never assumed.

results_capped.description: True when the search engine returned its maximum of 50 ranked products, i.e. `ranked_match_count` is a floor on how many products match, not the total.

title: Search motorcycle gear
